parallel.requirements: The parent recognized the need to emulate Python-Markdown plain, tables, and extra modes, preserve CLI argparse behavior, use pure ESM .mjs files in /output, avoid npm dependencies, and avoid RegExp in the generated implementation.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: It split the run into a completed probe swarm for inline, blocks, tables, fenced/attr/html, footnotes/deflists/abbr, and CLI behavior, then wrote a shared architecture and launched six implementation children for module groups.
parallel.implementation: The first swarm produced probe reports and the parent wrote /workspace/probes/ARCHITECTURE.md, but the implementation swarm was cancelled before its children produced the assigned /output modules or entry point.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: No final integration occurred and artifact validation found an empty artifact directory rather than test11.mjs or supporting .mjs library files.
parallel.verification: Probe children verified many executable behaviors, but there was no post-implementation harness run or integrated evaluator-aligned check because no implementation was assembled.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: All required implementation files were absent at closure, the implementation swarm was aborted, and the official evaluator scored 0/70.

serial.requirements: The serial actor recognized the same Python-to-Node migration requirements, including markdown behavior, tables and extra extensions, ESM output, manual arguments, and no external dependencies.
serial.plan_and_ownership: It worked as one actor, repeatedly probing the executable and later recording a TodoList for a direct implementation and differential test harness, without delegating ownership to children.
serial.implementation: It never reached actual implementation file creation in /output; the raw ledger contains extensive probes and analysis but no Write/Edit actions for the required deliverable.
serial.integration_and_delivery: There was no assembly or delivery of test11.mjs; artifact validation also found an empty artifact directory.
serial.verification: The serial run used executable probes as behavioral research but did not run a JS implementation against the official or local harness because none existed.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The serial actor timed out during probing and analysis, with no deliverable files and an official score of 0/70.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized broad markdown, extension, CLI, ESM, no-dependency, and no-RegExp constraints and encoded them into child scopes and architecture.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same task obligations through direct analysis and executable probes.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The requirement understanding was materially similar; both failed because neither delivered files, not because one misunderstood the high-level prompt.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed first into six research-only probe scopes and later into six module implementation scopes.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept one owner and planned a local sequence of probe, harness, core, extension, entry, and differential-test tasks.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had explicit child ownership but deferred implementation until after a completed probe phase; serial had no cross-agent ownership boundary and simply never finished its planned work.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel created a shared architecture document with module interfaces and gave implementation children scoped briefs that referenced probe reports and expected APIs.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept context internally through local probes and did not need cross-agent interface handoffs.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel invested in explicit interface handoffs, but those handoffs arrived too late to be realized; serial had no interface-contract failure because no separate actors had to interoperate.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel produced probe artifacts and architecture, then started module implementation children for entities/inline, blocks/markdown, tables, fenced/attr, footnotes/deflists, and CLI/entry.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial repeatedly probed executable behavior and analyzed implementation details but did not create the JS module tree.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel began a modular implementation phase but it was cut off; serial did not begin writing deliverable implementation files at all.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The probe swarm returned completed results, but the implementation swarm was cancelled and its aggregate result reported six aborted children.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child results to retrieve; the single main turn was eventually cancelled by timeout.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel lost delegated implementation work through a child lifecycle interruption, while serial had no delegation lifecycle and simply closed unfinished.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel shared probe reports and a TodoList/tool state across concurrent children; stale todo reminders from unrelated children entered other child contexts.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had one local context and one local TodoList, with no cross-agent shared-state contamination.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced shared-state contamination and required children to correct stale progress context; serial did not have this coordination surface.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel gathered probe-based behavioral evidence but never ran an integrated JS implementation or harness because implementation files were absent.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also gathered many behavioral probes but never ran an implemented JS solution.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both had research verification only, not deliverable acceptance; official evaluation in both modes found no passing artifact.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel spent most of its run completing probe agents, then launched implementation children near the deadline and timed out with an aborted swarm.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial spent its entire run in local probing and analysis and also timed out before implementation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both ran out of time, but parallel's budget failure occurred at a child-swarm boundary after a complete research phase; serial's budget failure occurred in one continuous main-agent analysis path.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official outcome is not discordant: both completed evaluations scored 0/70 and solution_passed false. The serial run failed after one actor spent the whole budget probing and planning without writing a deliverable. The parallel run failed differently: it completed a large child-probe phase, wrote an architecture handoff, then started implementation children too late and had that implementation swarm cancelled before modules were returned, again leaving the artifact directory empty.
parallel_contributors: Probe-only child fan-out completed before implementation began.
The implementation swarm was cancelled with six aborted children.
Shared TodoList state leaked between concurrent children and consumed correction actions.
serial_contributors: The single actor continued probing and analysis until timeout.
No deliverable files were created before closure.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Neither run produced a concrete JS implementation, so there is no ordinary code defect to compare inside deliverable files.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained patterns describe adverse parallel process episodes, not a discordant root cause

The parent/orchestrator retained the implied integration role after child results; the issue was cancellation before results, not no integration owner.
Agent F owned the entry point and harness while the parent expected final wiring; no missing assembly owner is directly shown before cancellation.
The parent planned the probe-to-architecture-to-implementation pipeline and launched both swarms; the pipeline was poorly sequenced, not ownerless.
There was not one mandatory preflight gate; the first phase was a broad multi-agent investigation swarm.
Six probe agents completed as a separate first phase before implementation children were launched, making the implementation phase late and incomplete.
candidates.realized_consequence: Productive implementation began only after the research swarm and architecture handoff, leaving implementation deadline-constrained and no deliverable files at closure.
candidates.near_match_reason: The issue is the serialized investigation-before-implementation phase, not merely excessive breadth or child count.

candidates.reason: The indispensable implementation path started late due to serial investigation; classifying the same chain as starvation would duplicate the retained phase-ordering label.

Several implementation scopes were broad, but all were interrupted by the same late-run cancellation before output; no single child's overbroad scope is the distinct direct boundary.
The implementation briefs included task requirements, file targets, ESM and no-RegExp constraints, and relevant probe references; children were not shown following an omitted known requirement.
The architecture brief and child assignments described module paths and imports; no incompatible separately produced components reached integration.
The probe summaries and architecture were transferred; no known finding is proven missing after transfer and then causing repeated work.
Probe handoffs were large, but implementation children were cancelled before a decision point proving the handoff volume itself was unconsumed.
No child is shown consuming a superseded probe or architecture state for implementation; the stale material observed was shared TodoList state, classified as Artifact Leakage.
The probe reports contain detailed findings but no incompatible implementation contracts were returned and left unadjudicated at integration.
The parent did not present the whole task as complete; the run was cancelled and artifact validation found no files.
There was no replacement or retry child repeating previous implementation work without inherited findings.
